sections.title: Bringing Unit 11 together
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Unit 11: naming a hobby with its -ni infinitive after szeretek, going somewhere as a regular habit with jár, saying what interests you with engem érdekel, and describing how often you do something with words like időnként and hétvégente.

sections.title: Hobbies and sport, recapped
rows: to hike, to have a picnic

items.english: In my free time I like photographing and gardening.

items.spanish: Hétvégente futni járok, mert engem nagyon érdekel a sport.
items.english: On weekends I go running, because I'm very interested in sport.

items.spanish: Időnként kirándulunk, de attól függ, van-e időnk.
items.english: We occasionally go hiking, but it depends on whether we have time.

sections.content: Keep the scale of liking in order: kedvel (to like a little) < szeret (to like) < imád (to love, to adore), with utál (to hate) at the opposite end. unatkozik (to be bored) and unalmas (boring) go together, just like kikapcsolódik (to unwind) and izgalmas (exciting).
